description: This Java class defines an OCR service component within a receipt and expense management platform. It contains a mock implementation of text extraction from uploaded files, returning a simple string containing the filename.

classes.name: OcrService
classes.description: A Spring service component that provides a method to extract text from uploaded files, currently implemented as a mock.

methods.name: extractText
methods.description: A public method that takes an uploaded MultipartFile and returns a mock extracted text containing the filename.
